## Section
Before publishing a guide, check that **each step** tells the reader what to do and where to do it. Use *italics* for a term the reader will see again, and put a command such as `git status` in inline code. Read the draft from top to bottom to check that the steps follow the order in which the reader will perform them. Verify any command examples against the [docs]
